concepts.name: 펼쳐서 흡수
concepts.build: 접힌 판 3개 피벗 회전 + 아이콘 이동 + 짧은 궤적
concepts.flow: 02: navy clip lifts a tiny amount, the three rigid cream paper panels fan open like a small accordion, amber sword relief begins to detach as a glowing FLAT icon, first moment of contact and immediate small '공격력 +14%' popup. 03: open paper stays briefly at source and fades while ONE small amber sword icon travels on a very short thin curved gold ribbon FROM paper TO side of existing cyan sneaker, icon near shoe, no duplicate large sword, one readable flow. 04: paper and clip are completely gone; one tiny sword-outline glow on shoe side fades while shark continues running, normal shoe unchanged, no attached paper. Signature is clearly visible accordion opening then clean icon transfer.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE premium landscape 1536x1024 storyboard explaining a mobile runner bonus pickup animation.
REFERENCE IMAGE: user's FAVORITE number 03 "접힌 부적". Preserve the exact object: stiff warm ivory folded paper body, navy printed geometric border, bottom with two squared tails, navy metal clip with single silver rivet at top, thick teal HEART or amber SWORD icon on front. Show selected ATTACK talisman in AMBER for the entire action. First frame may show unselected teal heart talisman on left. Environment identical sunny stylized Korean harbor wooden boardwalk in all frames; same player gray shark and existing cyan-white sneakers. Same art polish as reference, clean cel shading, broad highlights. Reference character has confusing feet overlap: avoid inventing anatomy, use a clean rear three-quarter cropped foot close-up in frames 2/3, and existing small rear-view shark in frames 1/4. Shoe upper and sole design unchanged.
LAYOUT: 2x2 grid of FOUR chronological numbered frames, read upper-left then upper-right then lower-left then lower-right. White/warm cream page with clean bright cream header, dark navy title, thin navy panel edges. NO blue vignette on header. Each frame ONE moment in time, not a collage. Upper-left = ordinary gameplay approach, upper-right = trigger/activation close-up, lower-left = specific transfer motion close-up, lower-right = readable normal gameplay after effect. Frame 4 MUST show continued running, NO leftover talisman at selected location, no persistent giant aura. Keep position/perspective consistent, shark advances naturally. No pauses, cuts to merchant, new buffs, weapon changes, healing potion, stopping pose or celebration animation.
Exact title supplied below. Small top-right "획득 연출 시안". Exact panel labels "01 · 다가가기", "02 · 닿는 순간", "03 · 힘이 들어간다", "04 · 계속 달리기".
FRAME 01: both talismans suspended low on left and right, exactly like reference. Left teal label "체력 +13", right amber label "공격력 +14%". Shark approaches right option, route ahead clear.
FRAME 02/03/04 obey the specific action supplied below. The numerical bonus is applied at initial contact in FRAME 02, not after a cinematic wait. In FRAME 04 use small restrained caption "강화 유지"; no second bonus increment, no new numeric damage example, do not show actual damage numbers or a health heal.
Bottom footer clean small exact text "항구 · 고속도로 · 휴게소 공통". Same entire pickup and sequence for all chapters; no chapter-specific objects or lore. No food, plates, roadside altars, stands.
Only 3-4 rigid planar parts, icon quad/relief and existing sneaker receiving a temporary small effect. Rigid hinge animation, translation, rotation, scale and fade; practical Unity implementation. No cloth simulation, ripping simulation, fluid, complex skeletal transformation or photoreal motion blur. Max a handful of round glints, no stars/confetti, no flames/smoke/poison, no vertical light column, no screen-covering flash, no arrows with uncertain direction. Keep effect localized to ONE visible shoe/ankle. Effect disappears; footwear does not permanently change.
Give every frame substantial space and ensure the distinct motion is visually readable, not four copies of an intact talisman with generic gold trails.
